name: web-threads
title: Web Threads
description: A full-bleed WebGL backdrop of thin luminous threads that cross, curve and gather at a glowing pinch point. The nearest thread brightens under the cursor, and clicks send a pulse of light along the web.
use: A product or AI landing hero needs a dark, glowing network backdrop that responds to the pointer.
avoid: It is a constant WebGL loop needing a sized parent and adds little on a light or content-heavy page.
a11y: The canvas backdrop is pointer-only and unlabelled; there is nothing for assistive technology to use. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Six long lavender-white lines sweep across black, dipping and rising in loose waves and meeting at a small intensely bright point in the middle. A short headline sits at the top.
behaves: The threads drift and their crossing point glides slowly across the stage. Hovering near a thread brightens it, and clicking sends a ripple of light travelling outward along the strands.
customise: Colours, thread count, speed, frequency, spread, pinch, nodes, glow, thickness, depth, pulses, intro, mouse strength and click pulse are props.
weight: heavy: A full-bleed fragment shader loops every frame over up to 24 glowing threads.
